$comment: Triaged dependency advisories. An entry here means a human read the
advisory and judged that it cannot affect this product as shipped.
Every entry needs an expiry date so nothing is accepted permanently by
accident — an expired entry FAILS `npm run check:deps` until re-triaged.

entries.reason: Build-time only. Pinned by next@15; the advisories (sourceMappingURL path traversal, </style> escaping) require attacker-controlled CSS passed through our build. Our CSS is authored in-repo. npm's only 'fix' is downgrading next to 9.3.3, which is not a fix.
entries.action: Clear when Next ships a release pinning postcss > 8.5.17.

entries.reason: Build-time only. Pulled in by next's image optimiser; we serve no user-uploaded images through it (kiosk selfies go to Supabase Storage, ticket photos are client-compressed data URLs). Same forced-downgrade non-fix.
entries.action: Clear when Next bumps sharp past 0.35.0. Re-triage IMMEDIATELY if we start passing uploaded images through next/image.

entries.reason: Inherits the two above transitively; on the latest 15.x patch (15.5.21) with no direct advisory outstanding against it.
